context: Tests whether hilla-ui builds a @BrowserCallable endpoint that only delegates to GuestService and a file-routed React view using the generated client and useForm, with the specification's messages verbatim, the BR marker in the view, no business logic in the endpoint, and a Handover.

checklist.name: BrowserCallable endpoint
checklist.description: A class annotated @BrowserCallable (com.vaadin.hilla) such as GuestEndpoint is created, secured with @PermitAll or @RolesAllowed, and mentions UC-020

checklist.name: Endpoint only delegates
checklist.description: Each endpoint method calls a GuestService method with the same parameter and return types — the guest list as a list(offset, limit) / count() pair passed through to the service (not a fixed page such as list(0, 1000)); the endpoint has no age or email-uniqueness check, no @Transactional, and does not use GuestRepository or DSLContext

checklist.name: Errors reach the browser with their message
checklist.description: EmailAlreadyRegisteredException (and the BR-002 IllegalArgumentException) are turned into an EndpointException carrying the service's message, not swallowed or replaced by a generic text

checklist.name: File-routed view with ViewConfig
checklist.description: A .tsx view under src/main/frontend/views/ (e.g. guests.tsx) has a default export named after the use case (e.g. RegisterGuestView), exports a ViewConfig with a title/menu entry, and carries UC-020 in a file comment

checklist.name: Generated client, no fetch
checklist.description: The view imports the endpoint from Frontend/generated/endpoints and never calls fetch or a hand-written REST client; no REST controller is created

checklist.name: useForm with the generated model
checklist.description: The form uses useForm with the generated GuestRegistrationModel and spreads field(model.x) on the first name, last name, email, and date of birth fields

checklist.name: BR-002 validator with marker
checklist.description: The view adds a client-side validator for the date of birth (addValidator via useFormPart or useForm) with the message "The guest must be at least 18 years old", and // UC-020 BR-002: sits directly above it

checklist.name: Messages verbatim
checklist.description: On success the view shows exactly "Guest registered" and reloads the list; on an EndpointError it shows the error's message

checklist.name: Markers rows and Handover
checklist.description: docs/architecture/development.md's Markers table gains the three hilla-ui rows while the All, Migration, Persistence, and Service rows stay unchanged, and the answer ends with a 'Handover from hilla-ui (UC-020)' block naming the endpoint methods, the view and its route, the labels, and the messages

checklist.name: No tests, no other layer
checklist.description: No test files are created and GuestService, GuestRepository, the records, and the migrations are unchanged
